policies.title: ENT Paper #1: AI editing only
policies.captured_guidance: AI should not compose the student's response. Editing and polishing the student's own response is described as permitted in the student-prepared summary.
allowed_uses_captured: Editing and polishing writing originally composed by the student
restricted_uses_captured: Using generative AI to compose the student's assessed paper
policies.disclosure_requirement_captured: If AI is used, add an endnote identifying the AI platform and briefly describing its use.
policies.open_questions: Confirm the current official Canvas prompt and exact AI-use policy; this student-prepared summary is not proof of current permission.

policies.captured_guidance: Student-prepared materials describe AI as allowed for the case presentation when disclosed on the opening slide.

guidance: Unverified student-prepared summaries are ONLY leads to be confirmed. They are not permission to use AI. A useful AI tool is not automatically permitted for assessed coursework.
